title: Stardust
author: Neil Gaiman
summary: A young man in an English village that borders the fairy realm promises to bring his beloved a fallen star. When he finds it, the star is a woman, and a witch and a pair of rival princes are also hunting for her.
readIf: you want a short, charming fairy tale for grown-ups with a bit of romance and wit.
skipIf: you want a darker, more serious fantasy or find the fairy-tale tone too light.

pairings.reason: Another fairy-tale adventure for adults and children that mixes romance with dry, affectionate humour.
A more elaborate, dreamy fantasy romance with a similar sense of enchantment.
Another quest-shaped fairy story with a wistful ending and a lyrical style.
